probe: Reward V3 reliability probe — objective-dominant budget
status: FROZEN — contract declared before launch; constants must NOT change after launch even if a seed looks bad at 150k
question: With shaping cut to fit an objective-scale budget, does ordinary PPO reliably learn to play CTF instead of finding a new farmable side quest?

action_failed_punishment.derivation: 0.0181 rescale from 184 observed failed commits/episode against a 30% safety budget

not_a_single_factor_ablation: V3 changes two reward families at once. It is a budget redesign and cannot attribute credit between the tag removal and the failed-commit rescale.

design.seed_freshness: disjoint from training (2500001-3), penalty ablation (2600001-3), tag ablation (2700001-3), aborted all-tag (2800001-3), discovery evaluation (9100000+), collapse diagnostic (9200000+), and TASK_HEALTH panel (9300000-9300002)

4_no_new_farmable_attractor.requirement: no measured shaping family may increase in magnitude while task performance decreases

REPORT_ONLY_NOT_FAILURE.note: provisional ceilings, not targets — lower is better. Exceeding one does NOT fail V3.
REPORT_ONLY_NOT_FAILURE.oob: entirely measurement-only. No OOB threshold is preregistered because its baseline frequency has never been observed; inventing one would repeat the error V3 exists to correct.

CLASSIFICATION.PASS: 3/3 alive AND >=2/3 competent AND no reward/task inversion in any seed AND no new farmable shaping attractor
CLASSIFICATION.MIXED: competence passes BUT alignment or farming condition fails
CLASSIFICATION.FAIL: alive gate or competence gate fails

known_caveat_recorded_before_results: The V3 per-episode budget projection is a DESIGN ESTIMATE, not a prediction of the new policy distribution. With failed_commit 55x cheaper, PPO may attempt far more macros, raising the event rate and partly offsetting the rescale. The measured V3 values are what count, not the projection.
post_launch_rule: Do not change any constant after launch, even if a seed looks bad at 150k.
